== Possibly faulty data: release date ==

Decipher's product history dates the Premiere Unlimited expansion and starter decks to February 1996. The collecting catalog dates the product to April 1996. The infobox and lead now follow the original publisher, while the catalog's April date is recorded here as a source disagreement.<ref name="decipher-date">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="collecting-date">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 4 and 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
